title: Recording media acceptance
description: What ./scripts/recording-integration.sh --phase=media emits after ffprobe and operator attestations, and what tests/recording_integration.rs checks. File facts come from ffprobe; the three candidate/interviewer presentation facts are marked operator-attested by x-codetrial-evidence until recorder-side telemetry replaces all three.

recording_id.description: The row this file belongs to, so a failed run names something an operator can look up.

expected_duration_seconds.description: How long the run says the room was up for. The duration is compared against this rather than against a constant, so a run cut short fails on its own terms; it is what the operator configured for the run, not something read back from the provider.

candidate_video_seconds.description: Operator-attested seconds that the candidate camera was visible in the template. An MP4 of a composited page cannot identify whose face was present.

audio_tracks.description: Operator-attested count of distinct candidate and interviewer audio sources heard in the room.

avatar_rendered.description: Operator attestation that the template's production VRM render was running. False until a model is published, which keeps this acceptance blocked on avatar work.
